characters.name: Elsa Quill
characters.description: A bell-founder's apprentice on Founder Row who can read a casting flaw at a glance and hears the wall's bells like voices.
characters.motivation: To prove the tenth ring was cast by a human hand and clear the collegium.
characters.goal: Trace the unmarked ring to its caster before the bells are stilled.
characters.flaw: She trusts craft rules too completely to see when they are being weaponised.
characters.internal_conflict: If the caster is not a founder, everything she was taught about marks is wrong.
characters.external_conflict: The parish watch has the writ to silence the wall and the will to use it.

abilities.name: Ring-sight
abilities.description: Reads a bell's casting flaws and its founder's mark from its ring.

characters.arc: Elsa learns that a mark is a signature, and signatures can be forged.

characters.name: Warden Hale
characters.description: The parish warden who signed the silence writ, whose own watch cast the unmarked bell to justify quietening the wall.
characters.motivation: To still the bells, which he believes trade safety for superstition.
characters.goal: Silence the wall before the next fog, whatever it takes.
characters.flaw: He has made an end so just that no means can shame him.
characters.internal_conflict: He knows the fog is real but fears the bells' hold on the parish more.
characters.external_conflict: Elsa's ring-sight can prove the unmarked casting was the watch's work.

abilities.name: Writ authority
abilities.description: Moves writs through the parish court faster than anyone can answer them.

characters.arc: Hale's own unmarked bell tolls his confession.

characters.name: Tallow
characters.description: A fog broker who trades in names from a licensed stall and knows which name the tenth bell was cast for.
characters.motivation: To sell what he knows before the fog calls in his own name-debt.
characters.goal: Trade the ringer's true name for his own safe passage.
characters.internal_conflict: Selling the name betrays the only client who ever paid fair.
characters.external_conflict: Both the watch and the founders would take the name without paying.

abilities.name: Name-keeping
abilities.description: Keeps a bought name safe in memory through any fog.

characters.arc: Tallow sells the truth cheap, for once, and buys back his name.

relationships.description: Tallow sells Elsa the clue to the unmarked bell's caster.
relationships.conflict: His price is a name-token she is sworn to protect.

relationships.description: Hale's silence writ is aimed at the wall Elsa maintains.
relationships.conflict: He rings the very treason he accuses the founders of.
